claims.assertion: Mari defines karma narrowly as action’s consequences and broadly as accumulated life and past-life experience shaping a unique soul.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says the broader meaning makes karma inescapable.

claims.assertion: One view treats karma as something to minimize to avoid further reincarnation; another says rich experience can reduce the need to return.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari favors living fully and responsibly, learning from others, forgiving oneself and others, and using wisdom to avoid serious mistakes without fearing karma.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
